item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-07-28
item.description: ## 今日发生了什么 ILE_LABS 先是在 Fiber-payjoin-kit 提案进入投票前更新了完成 Lightning 概念验证的进展 [S01]，但该提案因未能在 7 天内获得 30 赞而未能通过讨论阶段 [S02]，团队表示将整合社区反馈后重新提交 [S03]。与此同时，CKB Anywhere Card 的投票进入最后 24 小时倒计时 [S05]，多个新项目也在今日集中亮相。 ## 重点话题 **Fiber 隐私套件的推进与挫折**：ILE_LABS 宣布已完成 Lightning 版本的概念验证，并表示会在 Fiber 方案中复用这套经验 [S01]；但管理员 zz_tovarishch 指出该提案未达标通过讨论阶段，需实质性改进后重新提案 [S02]，团队确认将修订后再次提交 [S03]。 **CKB Anywhere Card 投票即将截止**：BuildUnion 发出最后号召，称投票剩余 24 小时，并强调提案在过去几天已根据社区讨论完成关于交易成本、授权框架等细节的优化 [S05]；社区成员 tdndo 进一步询问该卡是否支持跨链消费 BTC、USDT 等 RGB++ 资产，以及兼容钱包有哪些 [S06]。 **Fiber 生态工具持续上新**：duongja 今日发布了 FiberScope——一个面向 Fiber 网络的开源浏览器与基础设施诊断工具，已上线演示应用并开源代码 [S08]。 **Spark 项目进展与委员会反馈**：Gabriel_Temsten 对 Spore 元数据标准未获资助表示理解，认为委员会关于"底层 Spore...

item.title: Spark Program | Spore Metadata Standard and Reference Validator (1 posts)
item.description: Hi xingtian, Thanks for the transparency on the reasoning, it’s genuinely helpful to understand the committee’s thinking rather than just getting a yes or no. Makes sense that formalizing metadata conventions is premature while the underlying Spore spec is still settling. I’d rather come back with this once that’s a better fit than push it prematurely. One question so I know when to revisit: is there a specific milestone or signal on the Spore spec side the committee would consider a sign it’s ready for this kind of proposal, or is it more of a general “give it time” situation? Either way, appreciate the feedback and I’ll keep building in the meantime.

item.title: CKB Escrow: a decentralized escrow app for goods and services on Nervos CKB (1 posts)
item.description: Hi everyone, I have been building CKB Escrow, a decentralized escrow app for goods and services on Nervos CKB, and I would like to share the current progress with the community for feedback. The idea is simple: create a wallet-first escrow workflow for real deals between known parties. This is not a marketplace, storefront, listing platform, or reputation system. The goal is to focus on the escrow flow itself: Buyer creates and funds an escrow. Seller marks the goods or service as delivered. Buyer releases funds if satisfied. Buyer or seller can open a dispute if something goes wrong. Arbitrator reviews the dispute and resolves the escrow to buyer or seller. Why I Am Building This A lot...

item.title: CellScript - A DSL for Cell-Based Contracts (1 posts)
item.description: CellScript 0.22.0 Release Note CellScript 0.22 is out. You can install it with a single command, but the more important story lies underneath. Verification logic that once lived in strings, conventions, or implicit assumptions is now typed, finite, and explicit. Every proof obligation identifies who is responsible for discharging it, while the release gate binds clean source, pinned CKB source and binary provenance, generated artefacts, and committed transaction evidence into a single, auditable hand-off. The CellScript compiler and toolchain also now include preliminary integrations for RGB++, Spore, and Fiber, together with working examples for each. Install curl -fsSL...

item.title: Deep Dive Into CKB-VM Spawn Syscall (1 posts)
item.description: Deep Dive Into CKB-VM Spawn Syscall This article introduces one of the key features added to CKB script development: spawn, which was included in the CKB meepo hard fork. The meepo hard fork introduced several important changes, and spawn is one of its major additions. In ckb script, spawn refers to a concept and a set of syscalls used for creating new processes. Unlike exec syscall, introduced during the mirana hard fork, spawn provides a more direct way to enable cross-script calls, making the process simpler while offering greater control and optimization.
